messages:
Alyssa (CS): Pasting a customer escalation — AcmePay noticed a clear degradation after last night's rollout. Responses are shorter, sometimes wrong facts, and examples we had before now hallucinate. They reported after 23:40 UTC deploy.

Miguel (Infra): deploying canary rolled at 2026-03-16T23:38Z, that was the quant profile switch to int8-default-20260316. I tagged the deploy: deploy-bot #deploy-1819999000 :rocket:.

Alyssa (CS): Customer says it only started on their traffic (private dedicated). They provided a payload and a before/after pair. Asking for priority: they are on Dedicated with SLA and sensitive docs.

Pat (Support): Can you paste the minimal repro they sent? we should try to reproduce on staging.

Alyssa (CS): Here is the example they used (sanitized):

```
POST /v1/generate
model: redwood/rw-13b-v2
quant: INT8
input: "Summarize: The Q3 audit found no evidence of misallocation in the ledger. List reasons why this is incorrect."
params: {max_tokens:120, temperature:0.0}
```

Before (pre-rollout): produced a 5-bullet factual refutation with citations. After (post-rollout, INT8 profile): produced a short 1-2 sentence vague assertion and introduced a wrong date.

Joel (ML): Sounds like a profile shift causing numerical drift in attention or logits scaling. INT8 can change logits ordering for borderline tokens. Do we have the quant profile artifacts used in prod? Which calibration dataset?

Miguel (Infra): Profile name int8-default-20260316. Calibration set was full-sequence-5000 from perf run, but I see we excluded long-tail tokens during calibrate step to save time. I will pull the profile file.

Evelyn (CS): Customer included a deterministic option (temp 0). They also ran many repeated prompts and saw consistent differences. They pasted model response diffs. They want rollback until we triage.

Alyssa (CS): Customer requests rollback to previous variant (fp16 baseline) or we isolate them to old profile. Is that doable quickly?

Miguel (Infra): We can pin a rollout override per-customer in Dedicated config. Two options: (1) immediate rollback for their pool to fp16 baseline, (2) create per-tenant override to use int8-safe-20260228 profile which had broader calib. Option 1 is faster but impacts capacity. Which do we pick?

Pat (Support): If rollback, we should also gather exact seed/prompt/backtrace and latency traces. I'll ask customer for logs and request span IDs.

Alyssa (CS): Customer provided spans: span_id=acme-4231-03, request_ids list included. Pasting one request id: req_7f2b1.

Miguel (Infra): Pulling logs for req_7f2b1 now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout int8-default-20260316 -> 60% traffic at 2026-03-16T23:38Z for cluster ded-prod-eu1.

Miguel (Infra): Found the request in logs. Latency is normal. Model loaded with int8-default-20260316. KV cache warm, no OOMs. Token probs snapshot attached (excerpt):

```
Token: "2023" prob pre: 1.2e-3 prob post: 9.8e-4 rank_pre: 12 rank_post: 4
Token: "report" prob_pre: 8.1e-3 prob_post: 1.2e-3 rank_pre: 3 rank_post: 9
```

Joel (ML): That token rank flip is concerning: a token moved up in rank post-quant. This can flip answer decisions. Might be due to asymmetric quantization scale or per-channel clipping. We should compare activation distributions and check per-layer scale saturation.

Miguel (Infra): I exported int8-default-20260316 profile metadata: calibration bins used 256, per-tensor linear quant, clip at 3-sigma for a few layers. The older int8-safe-20260228 used per-channel with 1024 bins and percentile clipping at 99.995%.

Evelyn (CS): Customer asked for an ETA. They want rollback now.

Joel (ML): Recommend immediate mitigation: pin their tenant to int8-safe-20260228 while we run a regression test. Also run a token-level diff harness across their prompt corpus (small batch) to estimate divergence rate. I can run the diff locally if someone gives me model weights + profile mapping for both profiles.

Pat (Support): I'll request permission from the customer for us to run tests on a mirror of their workload. Also ask for the corpus of ~30 prompts they sent.

Alyssa (CS): Customer approved testing on a mirror. They want rollback until final sign-off. I'll schedule the change.

Miguel (Infra): Rolling per-tenant override now to int8-safe-20260228 for AcmePay pool. Patch:

```
PATCH /internal/dedicated/pools/acmepay
{ "quant_profile": "int8-safe-20260228" }
```

deploy-bot: Rollout override applied to pool acmepay at 2026-03-17T00:04Z by miguel.

Alyssa (CS): Customer confirmed immediate improvement in a handful of quick checks: longer, more factual responses. They still want a full regression matrix and a root cause.

Joel (ML): Next steps:
- Compare per-layer quant scales between the two profiles.
- Run 200-sample prompt diff harness and compute token-level flip rate and rank drift distribution.
- Re-run calibration with full token coverage and test candidate clipping strategies (per-channel vs per-tensor).

Miguel (Infra): I'll attach the two profile artifacts and a link to logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/ded/acmepay/req_7f2b1 and s3://profiles/int8-default-20260316.meta and s3://profiles/int8-safe-20260228.meta

Pat (Support): I'll own the customer comms and confirm rollback until Joel signs off on a safe promotion.

Evelyn (CS): Thanks team. Please add any short-term mitigations you think are safe. Also flag if there is cost impact for the rollback.

Miguel (Infra): Note: pinning to int8-safe increases average token cost by ~6% due to compute delta. Budget approval might be needed for prolonged pinning.

Alyssa (CS): I'll note cost to customer and ask if they want us to absorb for incident window.

Joel (ML): I'll start the diff runs now and post a short report in this thread in ~2 hours. If we see localized layer saturation, we might produce an updated profile that preserves int8 perf but avoids the drift.

Pat (Support): Customer is looping in legal & security for any audit questions. I'll add them to updates.

Alyssa (CS): Great work. Keeping this high priority. :white_check_mark:

Joel (ML): Report (2h): initial 200-sample diff shows 8.5% token rank flips above threshold and 12 prompts with semantic divergence. Sharing detailed CSV in next message.

Miguel (Infra): Noted. I'll start a scheduled job to re-calibrate using per-channel 1024-bin histogram and tighter percentile clipping, then run Joel's harness overnight.

Alyssa (CS): I'll keep customer updated and close once we have a timeline for safe re-promotion.

Pat (Support): Closing loop: customer very appreciative of fast pin. Marking escalation resolved pending final RC report. :thumbsup:
